lookahead_policy: Every feature uses only the current minute and information timestamped at or before it. Lagged returns and rolling anomaly features are backward-looking; no future price, public-announcement outcome, enforcement outcome, or unreleased content is accepted as an input.
purpose: Backward-looking surveillance feature construction from lawful historical market data; not a trading signal.
score_policy: Robust z-scores are preferred when present; conventional z-scores are fallback only.
